fullPassage:
Choosing a career is one of the biggest life decisions young people face. Mapping out the right career path can be demanding. While some teenagers have a clear vision of their career goals, others struggle to define them. This is where role models can be useful. They help young people start to plan their careers by providing them with guidance and the sense of purpose they need to succeed. We asked our teenage readers about their role models and the qualities they admire most in them. After you read each student's story, you will get a better idea of the profound impact role models can have when it comes to shaping career goals.

Minji: My role model is Jacques Cousteau, a French ocean explorer, inventor, and filmmaker. He dedicated his life to exploring and documenting the wonders of the underwater world. As a young man, he dreamed of becoming a pilot, but then he broke both of his arms in a terrible car accident. As part of his physical therapy, Cousteau began swimming. He became intrigued by the mysteries of the ocean, and he wanted to explore further. However, the diving equipment available at that time was insufficient. Instead of giving up, Cousteau decided to create his own equipment. After a long series of failed attempts, he finally succeeded in developing a portable breathing device, which he called the "Aqua-Lung." Cousteau shared his underwater experiences with the world in a compelling documentary film released in 1956. It transformed people's perceptions of the ocean and promoted the need for marine conservation. Cousteau's curiosity drove him to constantly challenge himself in new areas, and his passion enabled him to make the impossible a reality. Cousteau's life story inspired me to push the boundaries of what I can do. Because of him, I am not afraid to try different things in life. I will keep exploring until I find what suits me best.

Sunho: When people ask me about my role model, I always say that it is Joan Procter. You may not have heard of her, but she was a notable zoologist who specialized in reptiles in the early 20th century. She taught me that devotion to a particular field is important for shaping one's career. During her childhood, Procter immersed herself in the exploration of nature and animals. Although her father hated reptiles, she kept lizards, snakes, and even a baby crocodile as pets. They were special companions that she loved and took care of. She was a brilliant student, but health problems prevented her from attending university. However, her passion for zoology was so strong that it kept her moving forward, and she continued her studies on her own. Procter accumulated extensive knowledge of zoology. She began exchanging letters with George Boulenger, a prominent expert on reptiles, in order to share ideas. He was so impressed that he hired her as his assistant at the British Museum. A few years later, she became the first female curator of reptiles at the London Zoo. There, she actively contributed to the design of the Reptile House by incorporating new technology that allowed for better care and breeding of wild animals. Like her, I want to dedicate myself to a field that I have a passion for. For this reason, I will take my time to think deeply about where my true interests lie. If I am fortunate, one of my passions might someday lead to a rewarding career.

Yubin: As someone who loves animation, my role model has always been Kim Sang-jin. He was the first Korean animator to work for Walt Disney Animation Studios. Beyond the fact that he worked for a world-famous company, I admire him for pursuing his dream despite the difficulties he faced. From a young age, Kim was enthusiastic about drawing. However, his dream of studying art in college was disrupted when he was diagnosed with color vision deficiency during high school. Surprisingly, he didn't allow this misfortune to discourage him. Instead, he simply viewed his condition as a minor issue that could happen to anyone. Although he graduated with a degree in economics, he searched for a job related to art that wouldn't involve working with colors. He found out that some animators work only in pencil, so he sent his portfolio to all the animation studios in Korea. One of them gave him an opportunity, and he was finally able to start his career. It was his hard work and talent that eventually led him to a position at Disney at the age of 37. I give him a lot of credit for his persistence and his attitude toward the challenges in his life. I'll never give up on my dreams. If I encounter difficulties, I will simply find another way to pursue them, just as he did.

These stories shared by our readers emphasize the importance of role models in guiding teenagers toward their career goals. Role models, regardless of their field, inspire us because they possess qualities like persistence, commitment, and optimism. If you haven't found a role model yet, perhaps it's time to start searching for one. Try to find someone who can encourage you to take the first step in your career exploration.

questions.passage: Choosing a career is one of the biggest life decisions young people face. Mapping out the right career path can be (A)[demanding / effortless]. While some teenagers have a clear vision of their career goals, others struggle to define them. This is where role models can be useful. They help young people start to plan their careers by providing them with (B)[guidance / confusion] and the sense of purpose they need to succeed. After you read each student's story, you will get a better idea of the (C)[profound / shallow] impact role models can have when it comes to shaping career goals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 진로를 계획하는 것은 힘들 수(demanding) 있다. 안내(guidance)와 목적의식을 제공한다. 깊은(profound) 영향.
det.analysis:
✅ ① demanding — guidance — profound: 원문 일치
❌ ② effortless(쉬운): demanding의 반의어
❌ ③ confusion(혼란): guidance의 반의어
❌ ④ shallow(얕은): profound의 반의어
det.tip: demanding(힘든) ↔ effortless(수월한), guidance(안내) ↔ confusion(혼란), profound(깊은) ↔ shallow(얕은)

questions.passage: He dedicated his life to exploring and documenting the wonders of the underwater world. As a young man, he dreamed of becoming a pilot, but then he broke both of his arms in a terrible car accident. As part of his physical therapy, Cousteau began swimming. He became (A)[intrigued / indifferent] by the mysteries of the ocean, and he wanted to explore further. However, the diving equipment available at that time was (B)[insufficient / adequate]. Instead of giving up, Cousteau decided to create his own equipment. After a long series of failed attempts, he finally succeeded in developing a (C)[portable / stationary] breathing device, which he called the "Aqua-Lung."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 바다의 신비에 흥미를 느꼈다(intrigued). 장비가 불충분했다(insufficient). 휴대용(portable) 호흡 장치.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ intrigued — insufficient — portable: 원문 일치
❌ ① indifferent(무관심한): intrigued의 반의어
❌ ② adequate(충분한): insufficient의 반의어
❌ ④ stationary(고정된): portable의 반의어
det.tip: intrigued(흥미를 느끼는) ↔ indifferent(무관심한), insufficient(불충분한) ↔ adequate(충분한), portable(휴대용) ↔ stationary(고정된)

questions.passage: She was a brilliant student, but health problems prevented her from attending university. However, her passion for zoology was so strong that it kept her moving forward, and she continued her studies on her own. Procter accumulated (A)[extensive / limited] knowledge of zoology. She began exchanging letters with George Boulenger, a (B)[prominent / obscure] expert on reptiles, in order to share ideas. He was so impressed that he hired her as his assistant at the British Museum. A few years later, she became the first female curator of reptiles at the London Zoo. There, she actively (C)[contributed / objected] to the design of the Reptile House by incorporating new technology.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 광범위한(extensive) 지식을 축적했다. 저명한(prominent) 전문가. 적극적으로 기여했다(contributed).
det.analysis:
✅ ② extensive — prominent — contributed: 원문 일치
❌ ① limited(제한된): extensive의 반의어
❌ ③ obscure(무명의): prominent의 반의어
❌ ④ objected(반대했다): contributed의 반의어
det.tip: extensive(광범위한) ↔ limited(제한된), prominent(저명한) ↔ obscure(무명의), contributed(기여했다) ↔ objected(반대했다)

questions.passage: Cousteau shared his underwater experiences with the world in a <u>① compelling</u> documentary film released in 1956. It transformed people's <u>② perceptions</u> of the ocean and promoted the need for marine conservation. Cousteau's curiosity drove him to constantly challenge himself in new areas, and his passion enabled him to make the <u>③ impossible</u> a reality. Cousteau's life story inspired me to <u>④ narrow</u> the boundaries of what I can do.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ 원문은 내가 할 수 있는 것의 경계를 '밀어 넓히다(push)'인데, '좁히다(narrow)'로 바뀌었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① compelling: 매력적인, 원문 일치
✅ ② perceptions: 인식, 원문 일치
✅ ③ impossible: 불가능한 것, 원문 일치
❌ ④ narrow(좁히다) → push(밀어 넓히다): 반의어로 교체됨
det.tip: push the boundaries(경계를 밀어 넓히다) ↔ narrow the boundaries(경계를 좁히다). Cousteau에게서 영감을 받아 한계를 '넓히겠다'는 맥락.

questions.passage: During her childhood, Procter <u>① immersed</u> herself in the exploration of nature and animals. Although her father hated reptiles, she kept lizards, snakes, and even a baby crocodile as pets. She was a brilliant student, but health problems <u>② prevented</u> her from attending university. However, her passion for zoology was so strong that it kept her moving forward. Procter <u>③ accumulated</u> extensive knowledge of zoology. He was so impressed that he hired her as his <u>④ competitor</u> at the British Museum.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ 원문은 그녀를 자신의 '조수(assistant)'로 고용했는데, '경쟁자(competitor)'로 바뀌었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① immersed: 몰두했다, 원문 일치
✅ ② prevented: 막았다, 원문 일치
✅ ③ accumulated: 축적했다, 원문 일치
❌ ④ competitor(경쟁자) → assistant(조수): 감명을 받아 '조수'로 고용한 맥락에서 '경쟁자'는 부적절
det.tip: assistant(조수) ↔ competitor(경쟁자). Boulenger는 Procter의 실력에 감명받아 조수로 고용했다.

questions.passage: From a young age, Kim was <u>① enthusiastic</u> about drawing. However, his dream of studying art in college was disrupted when he was diagnosed with color vision deficiency during high school. Surprisingly, he didn't allow this misfortune to <u>② discourage</u> him. Instead, he simply viewed his condition as a <u>③ major</u> issue that could happen to anyone. Although he graduated with a degree in economics, he searched for a job related to art that wouldn't involve working with colors. It was his hard work and talent that eventually <u>④ led</u> him to a position at Disney at the age of 37.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ 원문은 자신의 상태를 '사소한(minor)' 문제로 여겼는데, '중대한(major)'으로 바뀌었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① enthusiastic: 열정적인, 원문 일치
✅ ② discourage: 낙담시키다, 원문 일치
❌ ③ major(중대한) → minor(사소한): 누구에게나 일어날 수 있는 '사소한' 일로 봤다는 맥락
✅ ④ led: 이끌었다, 원문 일치
det.tip: minor(사소한) ↔ major(중대한). Kim Sang-jin은 색각 이상을 낙담하지 않고 '사소한' 문제로 긍정적으로 바라봤다.

questions.passage: Choosing a career is one of the biggest life decisions young people face. Mapping out the right career path can be demanding. While some teenagers have a clear vision of their career goals, others struggle to define them. This is where role models can be useful. They help young people start to plan their careers by providing them with guidance and the sense of __________ they need to succeed.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 성공하는 데 필요한 목적의식(sense of purpose)을 제공한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ purpose: 목적, 원문 일치 — 롤모델이 진로 계획에 필요한 목적의식을 제공
❌ ① humor: 유머, 문맥 부적절
❌ ② duty: 의무, 문맥 부적절
❌ ④ urgency: 긴급함, 문맥 부적절
det.tip: sense of purpose(목적의식) — 롤모델이 청소년에게 진로 방향성과 목적의식을 제공한다는 핵심 내용.

questions.passage: He became intrigued by the mysteries of the ocean, and he wanted to explore further. However, the diving equipment available at that time was insufficient. Instead of giving up, Cousteau decided to create his own equipment. After a long series of failed attempts, he finally succeeded in developing a portable breathing device, which he called the "__________".
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Cousteau가 개발한 휴대용 호흡 장치의 이름은 Aqua-Lung이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① Aqua-Lung: 원문 일치 — Cousteau가 직접 명명한 휴대용 호흡 장치
❌ ② Deep-Dive: 허구의 이름
❌ ③ Ocean-Tank: 허구의 이름
❌ ④ Air-Mask: 허구의 이름
det.tip: Aqua-Lung — Cousteau가 개발한 수중 호흡 장치. 현대 스쿠버 다이빙 장비의 원형.

questions.passage: She was a brilliant student, but health problems prevented her from attending university. However, her passion for zoology was so strong that it kept her moving forward, and she continued her studies on her own. Procter accumulated extensive knowledge of zoology. She began exchanging letters with George Boulenger, a prominent expert on reptiles, in order to share ideas. He was so impressed that he hired her as his assistant at the British Museum. A few years later, she became the first female __________ of reptiles at the London Zoo.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 런던 동물원 최초의 여성 파충류 관리자(curator)가 되었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ curator: 관리자/큐레이터, 원문 일치 — 박물관이나 동물원의 전문 관리자
❌ ① visitor: 방문객, 문맥 부적절
❌ ② volunteer: 자원봉사자, 직업이 아님
❌ ③ director: 관장/이사, 유사하지만 원문 불일치
det.tip: curator(큐레이터/관리자) — 박물관, 동물원 등에서 소장품이나 동물을 전문적으로 관리하는 사람.

questions.passage: He dedicated his life to exploring and <u>documenting</u> the wonders of the underwater world. As a young man, he dreamed of becoming a pilot, but then he broke both of his arms in a terrible car accident.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 documenting과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 수중 세계의 경이로움을 탐험하고 기록하는(documenting) 데 일생을 바쳤다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② recording: 기록하다, documenting의 동의어
❌ ① destroying: 파괴하다, 반의어
❌ ③ ignoring: 무시하다, 반의어
❌ ④ inventing: 발명하다, 다른 의미
det.tip: documenting = recording: 기록하다. document는 명사로 '문서', 동사로 '기록하다'.

questions.passage: Cousteau shared his underwater experiences with the world in a <u>compelling</u> documentary film released in 1956. It transformed people's perceptions of the ocean and promoted the need for marine conservation.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 compelling과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 매력적인(compelling) 다큐멘터리 영화로 수중 경험을 세계와 공유했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ fascinating: 매혹적인, compelling의 동의어
❌ ① boring: 지루한, 반의어
❌ ② ordinary: 평범한, 반의어
❌ ③ confusing: 혼란스러운, 다른 의미
det.tip: compelling = fascinating = captivating: 매력적인, 눈을 뗄 수 없는. 강한 관심을 끄는 뉘앙스.

questions.passage: Surprisingly, he didn't allow this misfortune to discourage him. Instead, he simply viewed his condition as a minor issue that could happen to anyone. Although he graduated with a degree in economics, he searched for a job related to art that wouldn't involve working with colors. It was his hard work and talent that eventually led him to a <u>position</u> at Disney at the age of 37.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 position과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 37세에 디즈니에서 직위(position)를 얻게 되었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① post: 직위/자리, position의 동의어 (직업 맥락)
❌ ② location: 위치, 다른 의미
❌ ③ posture: 자세, 다른 의미
❌ ④ opinion: 의견, 다른 의미
det.tip: position = post = role: 직위, 직책. position은 다의어: 위치/직위/입장/자세.

questions.passage: You may not have heard of her, but she was a <u>notable</u> zoologist who specialized in reptiles in the early 20th century. She taught me that devotion to a particular field is important for shaping one's career.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 notable과 의미가 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: 그녀는 20세기 초에 파충류를 전문으로 한 저명한(notable) 동물학자였다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ unknown: 알려지지 않은, notable의 반의어
❌ ① remarkable: 주목할 만한, 동의어
❌ ② distinguished: 저명한, 동의어
❌ ④ famous: 유명한, 동의어
det.tip: notable(저명한) ↔ unknown(알려지지 않은). remarkable, distinguished, famous는 모두 동의어.

questions.passage: I give him a lot of credit for his <u>persistence</u> and his attitude toward the challenges in his life. I'll never give up on my dreams. If I encounter difficulties, I will simply find another way to pursue them, just as he did.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 persistence와 의미가 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: 그의 끈기(persistence)와 삶의 도전에 대한 태도를 높이 평가한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② surrender: 포기/항복, persistence의 반의어
❌ ① determination: 결단력, 동의어
❌ ③ perseverance: 인내, 동의어
❌ ④ tenacity: 끈기, 동의어
det.tip: persistence(끈기) ↔ surrender(포기). determination, perseverance, tenacity는 모두 동의어.

questions.passage: Choosing a career is one of the biggest life decisions young people <u>face</u>. Mapping out the right career path can be demanding. While some teenagers have a clear vision of their career goals, others struggle to define them.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 face와 같은 의미로 사용된 것은?
ch: She washed her face with cold water.
The building's face was covered with ivy.
We must face the reality of climate change.
He turned his face toward the window.

det.korean: 젊은이들이 직면하는(face) 가장 큰 인생 결정 중 하나.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ face the reality: 현실에 직면하다 — 본문과 같은 '직면하다' 의미
❌ ① face(명사): 얼굴
❌ ② face(명사): (건물의) 외관/표면
❌ ④ face(명사): 얼굴
det.tip: face: ① 얼굴(명사) ② 표면/외관(명사) ③ 직면하다(동사). 본문에서는 ③의 동사 의미.

questions.passage: Like her, I want to dedicate myself to a field that I have a passion for. For this reason, I will take my time to think deeply about where my true interests <u>lie</u>. If I am fortunate, one of my passions might someday lead to a rewarding career.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 lie와 같은 의미로 사용된 것은?
ch: He told a lie to avoid punishment.
The cat was lying on the sofa.
She never lies about her grades.
The answer lies in understanding the problem.

det.korean: 나의 진정한 관심사가 어디에 있는지(lie) 깊이 생각하겠다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ The answer lies in: 답은 ~에 있다 — 본문과 같은 '존재하다/~에 있다' 의미
❌ ① a lie(명사): 거짓말
❌ ② lying on(동사): 눕다/놓여 있다 (물리적 위치)
❌ ③ lies(동사): 거짓말하다
det.tip: lie: ① 거짓말(하다) ② 눕다/놓여 있다 ③ (추상적으로) ~에 있다/존재하다. 본문에서는 ③의 의미.

questions.passage: She taught me that __________(devote) to a particular field is important for shaping one's career. During her childhood, Procter immersed herself in the exploration of nature and animals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: 특정 분야에 대한 헌신(devotion)이 진로를 형성하는 데 중요하다.
det.analysis:
✅ devotion: devote(헌신하다)의 명사형 — 주어 자리이므로 명사가 와야 함
❌ devote: 동사 원형, that절의 주어 자리에 부적절
❌ devoted: 형용사/과거분사, 주어 자리에 부적절
❌ devoting: 동명사도 가능하나 원문은 devotion
det.tip: devote(동사: 헌신하다) → devotion(명사: 헌신). that절의 주어 자리에 명사가 필요.

questions.passage: Role models, regardless of their field, inspire us because they possess qualities like persistence, commitment, and __________. If you haven't found a role model yet, perhaps it's time to start searching for one.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

주어진 단어: optimistic

det.korean: 끈기, 헌신, 그리고 낙관주의(optimism)와 같은 자질을 가지고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ optimism: optimistic(낙관적인)의 명사형 — persistence, commitment과 병렬(and)이므로 명사 필요
❌ optimistic: 형용사, 명사 병렬 구조에 부적절
❌ optimistically: 부사, 명사 병렬 구조에 부적절
det.tip: optimistic(형용사: 낙관적인) → optimism(명사: 낙관주의). and로 연결된 병렬 구조에서 품사 일치 필요.

questions.passage: Cousteau shared his underwater experiences with the world in a compelling documentary film released in 1956. It transformed people's perceptions of the ocean and promoted the need for __________. Cousteau's curiosity drove him to constantly challenge himself in new areas, and his passion enabled him to make the impossible a reality.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사람들의 해양 인식을 바꾸고 해양 보전(marine conservation)의 필요성을 촉진했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② marine conservation: 해양 보전, 원문 일치 — 해양 다큐멘터리 맥락
❌ ① space exploration: 우주 탐사, 문맥 부적절
❌ ③ film production: 영화 제작, 목적이 아님
❌ ④ military research: 군사 연구, 문맥 부적절
det.tip: marine conservation(해양 보전) — Cousteau의 다큐멘터리가 해양 보호의 필요성을 알렸다.

questions.passage: These stories shared by our readers emphasize the importance of role models in guiding teenagers toward their career goals. Role models, regardless of their field, inspire us because they possess qualities like persistence, commitment, and optimism. If you haven't found a role model yet, perhaps it's time to start searching for one. Try to find someone who can encourage you to take the first step in your career exploration.
questions.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 영어 표현과 우리말 뜻이 잘못 짝지어진 것은?

det.korean: exploration은 '탐색/탐구'이지, '착취'가 아니다. 착취는 exploitation.
det.analysis:
✅ ① persistence = 끈기: 정확
✅ ② commitment = 헌신: 정확
❌ ③ exploration(탐색/탐구) ≠ 착취: 착취는 exploitation
✅ ④ regardless = ~에 상관없이: 정확
det.tip: exploration(탐색/탐구) vs exploitation(착취/이용). ex- 접두사가 같아서 혼동 주의!
